## Activity

During October 2025, Central Eye Clinic recorded 189 retinal image captures. This represents the activity completed at the site during the reporting month. The service should continue to monitor capture volumes and any operational factors that may affect the completeness or timeliness of the programme.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.6 per cent. This result should be reviewed through routine quality monitoring, with attention given to recurring technical or equipment-related issues. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 53 referable results. The median lag from image capture to grading was 1 day. Ongoing monitoring of the grading pathway is recommended to ensure that results continue to move promptly from capture through assessment and onward management where required. Together, the activity, image quality and grading measures provide a concise view of service performance for October 2025.
